subject.title: fix(mattermost): key private channels as group on outbound routing

question: Should this PR remain proof-blocked until the author posts inspectable redacted session-store or log output for the live private-channel cron delivery?
rationale: The screenshot shows a real Mattermost reply, but the behavior that decides merge safety is stored session namespace state that the screenshot does not display.

options.title: Require inspectable session proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted logs, terminal output, or a linked artifact show the patched private-channel delivery reused `group:<id>` without creating `channel:<id>`.

options.title: Accept the proof gap deliberately
options.body: A maintainer may merge after the code finding is fixed on source and unit-test evidence alone, but that owns the live session-store uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require inspectable session proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until redacted logs, terminal output, or a linked artifact show the patched private-channel delivery reused `group:<id>` without creating `channel:<id>`.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal for the authoritative private-channel chat-type behavior is the earlier inbound `P -> group` mapping landed through steipete.
